title: Etale structure-sheaf cohomology in smooth proper curve families
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to S$ a proper smooth morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] with nonempty geometrically connected fibres [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] of dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$ and $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}$ be the associated etale structure-module sheaves [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], placed in the same coefficient universe as the abelian direct-image and Artin--Schreier functors. If a universe lift is used, each section group is $\operatorname{ULift}(\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V))$ with the transported addition and scalar action; the same sectionwise lift is used for $E_{\mathrm{et}}$ below. The natural map $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}\to f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$ is an isomorphism. There is a finite locally free $\mathcal O_S$-module $E$ (Zariski-locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O_S^{\oplus r}$ for a finite integer $r$ allowed to vary between opens) with
$$R^1f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}\cong E_{\mathrm{et}}$$
as $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}$-modules. These higher direct images are computed in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], with the natural scalar action induced by multiplication by pullbacks of base functions; $E_{\mathrm{et}}$ is as in [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module].

source.place: Tag 0GKA, label lemma-genus-in-nodal-family-of-curves, (a),(b), smooth-curve specialization; etale form using Tag 03P2, etale-cohomology.tex, label theorem-zariski-fpqc-quasi-coherent; the same assertion with a sectionwise coefficient-universe lift

proof.text: Smoothness gives flatness and local finite presentation; properness gives quasi-compactness and a closed-immersion diagonal, hence quasi-separatedness and finite presentation. Each fibre is proper and geometrically reduced. Geometric connectedness and the field $H^0$ criterion give the canonical isomorphism $\kappa(s)\cong H^0(X_s,\mathcal O)$.

For $K=Rf_*\mathcal O_X[0]$, perfect direct image applies to the rank-one module $\mathcal O_X$, flat over $S$. It gives perfectness and canonical arbitrary base change. The derived structure unit has invertible degree-zero fibres by Step 1 and no negative fibre cohomology. The degree-zero criterion gives $H^0(K)=\mathcal O_S$ by the structural map and locally $K\cong\mathcal O_S[0]\oplus P$, with $P$ perfect of positive Tor amplitude.

The fibre $X_s$ is quasi-compact and finite type over a field, hence Noetherian, and has dimension one. Dimension vanishing and derived base change kill $H^i(Li_s^*P)$ for $i>1$; positive Tor amplitude kills $i\le0$. The residue-model lemma thus represents $P$ near $s$ by one finite free term in degree one. Consequently $E=H^1(K)$ is finite locally free (thus quasi-coherent) and locally $K\cong\mathcal O_S[0]\oplus E[-1]$.

proof.text: Apply the affine coherent edge lemma to $G=\mathcal O_X$, $A=\mathcal O_S$ and $E$ from Step 3. It gives linear bijections $e_v:H^1(X_V,\mathcal O)\cong\Gamma(V,v^*E)$, compatible with all arrows between affine etale base objects.

source.place: Tag 0GKA, last sentence: compatible with base change

proof.text: Write $\mathcal P(V)=H^1(X_V{}_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal O_{X_V,\mathrm{et}})$. For affine etale $V$, properness makes $X_V$ quasi-compact separated. The simultaneous lifted comparison followed by $e_v$ gives bijections $b_V:\mathcal P(V)\cong L\Gamma(V,v^*E)$. Its pullback square gives restriction compatibility; its naturality for multiplication and linearity of $e_v$ give $b_V(ax)=a b_V(x)$. Use the same sectionwise lift $L$ throughout. The higher-image theorem identifies $R^1f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$ with $\mathcal P^\#$.

Affine open covers give cover density, and finite affine refinement of etale covers shows that the affine subsite topology is induced. On that subsite $b$ is a presheaf isomorphism to the sheaf $E_{\mathrm{et}}$. Affine-site equivalence and dense-subsite sheafification compatibility therefore give $\mathcal P^\#\cong E_{\mathrm{et}}$. Linearity holds globally since equality of the scalar-action morphisms is detected by faithful restriction. In degree zero, for affine etale $v:V\to S$, universal proper-flat global sections gives an $\mathcal O_V$-module isomorphism $f_{V,*}\mathcal O_{X_V}\cong\mathcal O_V$, so $B=\Gamma(X_V,\mathcal O)$ is free of rank one over $R=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, say $B=Re$. Writing $1_B=ce$ and $e^2=de$, the equation $e=1_Be=cde$ gives $cd=1$, so the structural pullback $R\to B$, $r\mapsto rce$, is bijective; degree-zero comparison identifies this with the structural etale map. The same faithful equivalence detects its invertibility.
